title: dnd-5e-2024 class stats (docs/rulesets.md#classes)
description: A page type: its features and options are components it lists in order. Stored inputs only; derives the proficiency bonus and spell slots by level, and its Features table rows and spell list from the library. Cross-field rules are checks in checks.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

primaryAbility.description: Printed "Strength or Dexterity", "Dexterity and Wisdom"; `join` is required with two or more abilities, and only then.

savingThrows.description: Exactly two abilities, printed "Strength and Constitution".

skills.description: Printed "Choose 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, … or Survival"; without `from`, "Choose any 3 skills (see “Playing the Game”)".

weapons.description: Weapon Proficiencies, as printed: "Simple and Martial weapons".

tools.description: Tool Proficiencies, as printed: "Choose 3 Musical Instruments".

armor.description: Armor Training, as printed: "Light and Medium armor and Shields", or "None".

multiclass.description: The bullets under "As a Multiclass Character", as printed. The template writes the "As a Level 1 Character" bullets, which every class shares.

features.description: Its class features, in printed order: by level, and in table order within a level.

subclassLevels.description: The levels that grant subclass features, ascending: [3, 6, 10, 14]. The first is the level of the class's "<Class> Subclass" feature; the Features table prints "Subclass feature" at the others.

columns.description: The Features table's class-specific columns, in order, each with its 20 values as printed ("2", "+2", "1d6", "+10 ft.", "—").

spellcasting.description: Its casting: the slots derive from `progression` (full, half, or pact), and `cantrips` and `prepared` give the Features table's columns, one number per level.

optionLists.description: Its option lists, such as Metamagic Options: each a heading, its intro, and its options in printed order.

spells.description: Existing spells that join its spell list, beside every spell whose `classes` names it. Only on a custom class.
